p: Gibeonites: Thinking to gratify the people, because these were not of the seed of Abraham.
What shall I do for you: With what may your wrath be appeased, that you may pray to God to remove this plague from his people.
any man in Israel: Save only of Saul's stock.
sons be delivered unto us: Of Saul's kinsmen.
unto the LORD in Gibeah of: To pacify the Lord.
Michal the daughter of Saul: Here Michal is named for Merab Adriel's wife, as it appears in 1Sa 18:19 for Michal was the wife of Paltiel, 1Sa 25:44 and never had a child 2Sa 6:23.
first days: Which was in the month Abib or Nisan which contained part of March and part of April.
sackcloth: To make her a tent in which she prayed to God to turn away his wrath.
water dropped upon them out of: Because drought was the cause of this famine, God by sending rain showed that he was pacified.
intreated for the land: For where the government permits faults to go unpunished, there the plague of God lies on the land.
the giant: Or, of Haraphah, the race of giants.
shekels of brass in weight: Which amounts to 9 3/4 pounds.
light of Israel: For the glory and wealth of the country stands in the preservation of the godly magistrate.
Gob: Called Gezer, and Saph is called Sippai, 1Ch 20:4.
Goliath the Gittite: That is, Lahmi the brother of Goliath, whom David slew, 1Ch 20:5.
